_comment: Model hyperparameters and documented constants, not season facts. Each field states its derivation so it can be checked rather than trusted.

fuel_effect_s_per_lap.derivation: Not yet fitted. Planned method: regress lap time on remaining-fuel-laps for green-flag laps on a single, unchanged-tyre stint early in a race, holding tyre life roughly constant across the sample; slope is the fuel effect in seconds per lap of fuel burned. Requires at least one 2026 race session's laps.json to fit.

quadratic_deg_r2_improvement_threshold.derivation: Engineering default: only prefer a quadratic tyre-degradation fit over a linear one if it improves R^2 by more than this margin, per pipeline/models/deg_fit.py. Not a season fact; safe to author directly.

min_reliable_degradation_samples.derivation: Engineering default (docs/SPEC.md M4: "a curve from 6 laps is not a curve"). Below this sample count deg_fit.py marks the fit unreliable rather than hiding the small sample.
